verdict.rationale: Pylon has a dedicated developer webhooks page: webhooks are user-defined HTTP callbacks triggered by specific events in Pylon (pylon-docs-32, pylon-docs-63). The bring-your-own-agent docs explicitly position webhooks as a way to connect agents into ticketing workflows (pylon-docs-16). Missing for 10: an enumerated list of subscribable event types, details on payload schema, signing/verification and retries, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
